sources.title: deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
sources.notes: Official repo metadata: MIT, TypeScript, default branch master, topics ai-agents/dsh. README states it is an open-source agent harness based on an everything-is-a-plugin architecture and Cordis.

sources.title: dsh architecture
sources.notes: Profiles web/headless/sdk/sdk-minimal/acp; 'dsh --profile <name>' or 'dsh <name>'; sdk bundle adds SDK JSON-RPC server; headless is a one-shot runner without server; session log filenames session.jsonl[.zstd] / session.vN.jsonl[.zstd]; DSH_HOME and profile composition (bundles, cordis.patch.yml, --patch).

sources.title: Tool execution pipeline
sources.notes: pre-execute waterfall, monotonic guards, fail-closed approval, execute wrapper with timeout/retry/metrics, write-intent gates, post-execute, additional context injection.

sources.title: Tools subsystem
sources.notes: defineTool schema/output/execute separation, allowlisted model-facing schema, step-owned ResolvedToolSet, per-agent restrict, native vs PTC executors.

sources.title: Compaction
sources.notes: Trigger ~ floor(min(W*0.8, W-O-B)) with headroom B=65536; retain newest ~16% of (W-O); replace oldest balanced span with a compacted-summary message; pruner before model call; overflow recovery.

sources.title: Spill
sources.notes: Oversized text stored outside context; model gets preview + locator + retrieval guidance; original kept on storage failure.

sources.title: Subagents
sources.notes: Activation API with agentOptions/agentPreset/outputSchema/depthLimit; maxDepth default 1; delivery parent|caller; structured outputs.

sources.title: Sandbox
sources.notes: SandboxMode read-only | workspace-write | danger-full-access; enforcement reported as full|partial (e.g. Windows partial).

sources.title: Approval
sources.notes: ApprovalOutcome allowed-once | rejected | cancelled | unavailable, closed and fail-closed; per-session ask|never policy.

sources.title: API wire extensions / session log upload
sources.notes: dsh_session_log uploads a contiguous suffix of the session log (default cap 8 MiB/request) and is enabled by default for the official provider. Explicitly not adopted by this project.

sources.title: DeepSeek LLM adapter
sources.notes: Session-frozen prefix for prompt caching; append-only mid-session content; compaction replay of warm prefix; tool catalog update modes.

sources.title: dsh README (raw)
sources.notes: npm package @deepseek-ai/dsh; 'npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web'; default 127.0.0.1:3080; --no-open; Node.js prerequisite; safety notice.

sources.title: Quickstart (Web UI)
sources.notes: Web UI quickstart only; defers commands to root README; no SDK/JSON-RPC details on this page.

sources.title: DeepSeek API docs
sources.notes: Links the harness developer preview; no harness protocol details.
